name: Cheeseburger Menu
description: This block is displaying the main menu and its child items in an ordered list
project_description:
Cheeseburger Menu is not just another mobile hamburger menu - it can be used on both mobile and/or desktop (you decide!), and it comes with some extra features (and cheese!).

 We have developed the Cheeseburger Menu to be as universal as possible, so it can be used by everyone on any of the desired screens.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Menu aggregator (combination of multiple standard menus and taxonomies) 
 Define your own custom colours 
 Custom menu icons (.svg) 
 No programming skills needed 
 Provides some useful menus like language switcher 
 
 Back to top 

 How to use: 
 
 Navigate to Administration > Extend and enable the module. 
 There is now a "Cheeseburger menu" block available to use. 
 Navigate to Administration > Structure > Block layout and select a region where to place the block. 
 Place Cheeseburger menu . 
 Drag and drop menus you want to have visible to Enabled section. 
 Save the block. 
 Once you have Cheeseburger menu setup , you should place Cheeseburger menu trigger the same way. 
 Choose which Cheesburger menu block should be triggered by the trigger. 
 Once everything is saved you can open/close your Cheeseburger menu by pressing the trigger.
